text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen, and everyone is talking about how this is the last race for the exceptionally talented Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan boldly proclaims that she won't let Oguri Cap be the star of this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap, Mejiro McQueen, and Mejiro Ryan are here…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And all three of them are putting their dreams on the line as the Arima Kinen begins!
